hypothesis: Turning the two larger white pearls into four-point glints while retaining the smaller round satellites should make the celestial motif more intentional and refined.
mutation: Black stationary 0.65-second contacts at the four diagonal offsets (+/-80,+/-80) around each large pearl centre: (700,800) and (365,1800). These overlap the white discs' diagonal edges without deliberately covering their axial tips.
acceptance: Both large marks must become clean, readable four-point glints without erasing neighbouring marks. Reject if they become ragged fragments, hard-to-read pinholes, or distract from the moon.
